description: Check a proposed payment against the agent's active policy before executing it. Returns ALLOW, HOLD, or BLOCK with a reason. Run this before every settlement call. ALLOW = proceed. HOLD = route to human review queue. BLOCK = halt, do not proceed.

agent_id.description: Agent identifier — must match the agent_id used in policy.create

delegation_id.description: If acting under a delegation from a parent agent, provide the delegation ID.

oracle_status.description: Current oracle status — STABLE, CAUTION, or UNSTABLE. Get from get_reliability.

session_id.description: Task or session grouping ID for ledger tracking.

name: policy.check
